headlines.title: Is GE Vernova (GEV) Undervalued As Earnings Reset The Valuation Debate?
headlines.summary: How the latest earnings reset the GE Vernova conversation GE Vernova (GEV) just dropped a dense third quarter earnings package, with revenue of US$12,642 million and net income of US$1,291 million, giving investors a fresh set of hard numbers to work with. GE Vernova’s share price has cooled after a strong run, with a 30 day share price return down 12.8% and a 90 day move down 15.3%, yet the year-to-date share price return of 26.9% and 1 year total shareholder return of 48.

headlines.title: GE Vernova Keeps Sliding Even After Raising Guidance: Why Guggenheim Sees 60% Upside
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova is 27% below its summer high, even after a third quarter in which orders rose 96% organically and management raised its 2026 guidance. Guggenheim cut its price target to $1,400 from $1,450 on Monday but kept its Buy rating, implying 60% upside.

description: GE Vernova Inc., an energy company, engages in the provision of various products and services that generate, transfer, orchestrate, convert, and store electricity in the United States, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates through three segments: Power, Wind, and Electrification. The Power segment designs, manufactures, and services gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam technologies. It serves industrial, government, and other customers. The Wind segment offers wind generation technologies, including onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades. The Electrification segment provides grid solutions; power conversion; electrification software; and solar and storage solutions technologies required for the transmission, distribution, conversion, storage, and orchestration of electricity from point of generation to point of consumption. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
